command: CURRENT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) && if [ "$CURRENT_BRANCH" != "distributed-main" ]; then echo '⚠️  WARNING: Pushing to '$CURRENT_BRANCH'. Agents should work on distributed-main branch.' && echo 'Switch with: git checkout distributed-main' && exit 1; fi
description: Ensure agents work on distributed-main branch

configuration.message: Agents must work on distributed-main branch for distributed coordination
